    <style>
:root {

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const form = document.getElementById('consent-form');
    const checkbox = document.getElementById('terms-consent');
    const errorContainer = document.getElementById('terms-error');

    form.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
        // Prevent default submission
        event.preventDefault();

        if (!checkbox.checked) {
            // Show error
            errorContainer.textContent = 'Error: You must agree to the Terms of Use to proceed.';
            errorContainer.hidden = false;
            checkbox.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
            
            // Move focus to the checkbox as per accessibility guidelines
            checkbox.focus();
        } else {
            // Success
            errorContainer.hidden = true;
            checkbox.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
            alert('Form submitted successfully!');
            // In a real app, you would submit the form data here
        }
    });

    // Clear error when user interacts with the checkbox
    checkbox.addEventListener('change', () => {
        if (checkbox.checked) {
            errorContainer.hidden = true;
            checkbox.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
        }
    });
});
    </script>
